## 3. Verified source record

The complete JSON entry below is copied from the current local source. Preserve its id, author_id, author_name, day, hour, knowledge_key, timestamp, and exact text. Candidate prose is editorial material, not part of the loaded row.

```json
{
  "id": "journal_raw_b3_39_courier_the_cartographer",
  "text": "I met the Cartographer. I sat at the cache and I waited and he came. He came the way the Hunter comes — watching before moving, moving only when he had watched. He set the distance at 4 metres. I did not stand. I offered the gifts before the questions. He took the mushrooms and the salt and the grow light tube and the map. He took the antibiotics last. His hands shook when he took the antibiotics. I did not say anything. The Surgeon's hands shook when he wrote the list (journal_raw_b3_17). The Cartographer's hands shook when he took the gift. The shaking is the thing that is the same in both men and the shaking is the thing that means the antibiotics are not a number. The antibiotics are a thing that makes hands shake. I gave him the 5 doses and his hands shook and I knew the 5 doses were the right thing to give because the giving is the thing that costs the giver and the receiver the same thing — the knowledge that the 5 are finite and the finite is the thing that is precious. He answered the questions. He spoke in long sentences with pauses. He said the wolves are a map. He said the spring is coming. He said the moss is the first. He said the bunker is a staying settlement that walks and that is rare. He said he needs the bunker to continue. He said the seeds need a place and the bunker is the place. He said plant the seeds. I will plant the seeds. I carried the bunker to the Cartographer and I carried the Cartographer's maps and seeds back to the bunker. The heaviest thing I have carried is not the fuel. The fuel was 67 kilograms. The relationship is heavier. The relationship does not fit in a container. It fit in the 3 hours. The 3 hours are the thing I carry now. The 3 hours are the heaviest and the lightest thing because the 3 hours are the thing that does not weigh anything and the thing that weighs everything. The Cartographer is the thing I am, outside the bunker. I am the thing the Cartographer is, inside the bunker. We are the same thing in different places. That is the relationship. That is the thing I wrote in the journal because the journal does not ask me to explain it. The relationship does not need explaining. The relationship is.",

  "author_name": "The Courier",
  "author_id": "the_courier",
  "knowledge_key": "courier_met_the_cartographer",
```

## 4. Fixed canon and open space

The Courier meets the Cartographer at a cache, offers mushrooms, salt, a grow-light tube, a map, and five antibiotic doses, and returns with maps and seeds. The Cartographer speaks of wolves, spring, moss, and the bunker as a settlement that walks and needs to continue. The Courier describes three hours and a relationship as both heavy and weightless. Do not add kinship, a signed agreement, or a gameplay relationship state. Candidate language may add an image, rhythm, or private impression as an editorial draft, but no proposed addition becomes a further remembered event or confirmed fact until the existing content owner selects and reviews it against the source.

## 5. Human center

The source voice is The Courier. The Courier’s exchange with the Cartographer includes goods, maps, seeds, questions, and the recognition that a relationship has weight without being cargo. Keep the four-metre distance, shaking hands, finite doses, and reciprocal language without inventing a family tie or new contract. The prose may notice what the author can count, hear, repair, fear, or leave uncertain, while keeping the account’s limits visible.

## 6. Voice and point of view

- **Source voice:** The Courier; retain the first-person register and concrete evidence of the existing entry.
- **Close-scene option:** a restrained view of an object or task already named in the row, without inventing a new action.
- **Margin option:** an editorial aside beside the journal text, never another authenticated entry.
- **Exchange option:** temporary, unnamed listener voices only; do not imply a new conversation occurred.
- **Return option:** reflective rereading, not a future journal entry, callback flag, or persistent-memory system.
